WCA 1980 round, census 1980. FAO flag A: Official figure. FAO's note: Agricultural holdings with 1 ha of cultivated area wholly or partly used for agriculture or forestry. All holdings with less than 1 ha but that met at least one of the following thresholds: 0.25 ha of vineyards, intensive fruit-growing plants, or hop or tobacco cultivation areas; 0.1 ha under horticultural and nurseries; one horse, one cattle, three pigs, five sheep/goats, or 50 poultry; or 20 bee-colonies. Holdings with less than 1 ha but with a market-oriented fishery production or mushroom cultivation establishments with a market-oriented production were also covered.

WCA 1990 round, census 1990. FAO flag A: Official figure. FAO's note: Agricultural holdings with 1 ha of cultivated area wholly or partly used for agriculture or forestry. All holdings with less than 1 ha but that met at least one of the following thresholds: 0.25 ha of vineyards; 0.25 ha of commercial fruit-bearing plants; 0.1 ha under horticultural cultivation or having greenhouse; one cattle, three pigs, five sheep/goats, or 50 poultry; or 20 bee-colonies. Holdings with less than 1 ha but with a market-oriented fishery production or mushroom cultivation establishments with a market-oriented production were also covered.

WCA 2000 round, census 1999/00. FAO flag A: Official figure. FAO's note: Agricultural holdings that met at least one of the following thresholds: 1 ha of utilized agricultural area (UAA); operators of commercial vineyards of at least 25 ares; 15 ares (0.15 ha) of intensively utilized fruit orchards, or 10 ares (0.1ha) under berries, strawberries, vegetables, hops, flowers and ornamental plants, or under vine or tree nurseries; or holdings with at least three head of cattle, five pigs, ten sheep, ten goats or 100 head of poultry of any type. The AC also included forestry holdings with at least 3 ha of woodland and holdings producing cultivated mushrooms for the market.

WCA 2010 round, census 2010. FAO flag A: Official figure. FAO's note: Agricultural holdings that met at least one of the following thresholds: 1 ha of utilized agricultural area (UAA); wine-growing holdings with at least 25 ares under market vines; 15 ares (0.15 ha) of intensively utilized fruit orchards, or 10 ares (0.1ha) under berries, strawberries, vegetables, hops, flowers or decorative plants, or under vine or forest, or nurseries; holdings that operate greenhouses (high/low glass or foil) covering at least one are (0.01 ha), the majority of the produce being grown for the market; or livestock holdings with at least three head of cattle, five pigs, ten sheep, ten goats or 100 head of poultry of any type. The AC also included forestry holdings with at least 3 ha of wooded area.

WCA 2020 round, census 2020. FAO flag A: Official figure.
